<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left"><div style="BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #000000;BORDER-LEFT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-RIGHT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-TOP:1px solid #000000;MARGIN-LEFT:0pt;MARGIN-RIGHT:0pt;max-width:100%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>APS BDC, LLC </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">SUBSCRIPTION INSTRUCTIONS </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This
subscription booklet (the &#8220;<U>Subscription Booklet</U>&#8221;) relates to the offering of units of limited liability company interests (&#8220;<U>Units</U>&#8221;) of APS BDC, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the
&#8220;<U>Company</U>&#8221;) that intends to elect to be treated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;<U>1940 Act</U>&#8221;). This Subscription Booklet contains all of the materials
necessary for you to subscribe for the Units. Prior to completing such materials, you should read the Company&#8217;s Form 10 Registration Statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<U>SEC</U>&#8221;), the Limited
Liability Company Agreement of the Company (as amended, modified and/or restated from time to time, the &#8220;<U>LLC Agreement</U>&#8221;), the Investment Advisory Agreement entered into between the Company and OHA Private Credit Advisors II, L.P.,
a Delaware limited partnership (the &#8220;<U>OHA Adviser</U>&#8221;), and the Investment Advisory Agreement entered into between the Company and CHS (US) Management, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &#8220;<U>Aranda
Adviser</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">You may apply to become a holder of Units of the Company (a &#8220;<U>Unitholder</U>&#8221;) by taking the following
steps: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">1.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Read the subscription agreement of the Company (the &#8220;<U>Subscription Agreement</U>&#8221;) (<B><I>Part
1</I></B>). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">2.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Fill in the name of the investor and the amount of the Capital Commitment (as defined herein) on the first page
of the Subscription Agreement (<B><I>Part 1</I></B>). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">3.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Complete the Investor Questionnaire (<B><I>Part 2</I></B>). For investors that are nominee, custodial or other
similar accounts, <B><I>Part 2</I></B> of this Subscription Booklet must be completed on behalf of the underlying investor(s) <I>and</I> such nominee / custodial or other similar account in its capacity as nominee, custodian or other similar party
for the underlying investor(s). If responses to questions in <B><I>Part 2</I></B> differ between the nominee / custodial or other similar account in its capacity as nominee, custodian or other similar party and the underlying investor(s), please
contact CHS (US) Management LP, whose contact information is set forth below. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">4.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Complete the Investor Data Sheet (the investor must provide all information regarding its identity, including
its name and tax identification number or social security number and all contact information) (<B><I>Part 3</I></B>). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>

conditions of both the Subscription Agreement and the LLC Agreement) (<B><I>Part 4</I></B>). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

forth in the LLC Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Except as otherwise indicated, all references herein to &#8220;$&#8221; or &#8220;dollars&#8221; are to U.S.
dollars. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>I. <U>SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT</U> </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Investor hereby irrevocably subscribes for Units with a capital commitment (the &#8220;<U>Capital Commitment</U>&#8221;) in the amount set
forth above and on the Investor&#8217;s signature page hereof (subject to reduction as provided below). The Units shall not be deemed to be sold or issued to, or owned by, the Investor (and the Investor&#8217;s subscription for the Units, in whole
or in part, shall not be deemed finally accepted) until the Investor is admitted as a Unitholder to the Company. The Investor acknowledges and agrees that the Aranda Adviser reserves the right, in its discretion, to admit the Investor as a
Unitholder to the Company on the date of any closing of the Company (each such date of admission, a &#8220;<U>Closing Date</U>&#8221;) and that the Aranda Adviser reserves the right, in its discretion, to reject this subscription for the Units, in
whole or in part, at any time prior to any Closing Date, notwithstanding execution by or on behalf of the Investor of the signature page hereof or notice from the Aranda Adviser of its conditional acceptance of the Investor&#8217;s subscription for
the Units. If this subscription is rejected in full, or in the event the Closing Date applicable to the Investor does not occur (in which event this subscription shall be deemed to be rejected), this Subscription Agreement shall thereafter have no
force or effect; provided that, notwithstanding the foregoing, if a portion of the Investor&#8217;s Capital Commitment is not accepted as of a Closing Date for any purpose set forth in the LLC Agreement or as otherwise agreed with the Investor
(while the remaining portion of the Investor&#8217;s Capital Commitment is accepted as of such Closing Date), then such portion of such Capital Commitment that was not accepted shall remain part of the Investor&#8217;s irrevocable subscription
pursuant to this Subscription Agreement (which shall remain in full force and effect) until the date on which the Aranda Adviser notifies the Investor in writing that such portion of its Capital Commitment that was not accepted will not be accepted
by the Company as of any subsequent Closing Date. During </P> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>

promulgated under the Securities Act with respect to the offer and sale of the Units. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">c. The information relating to the

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>senior political figure</U>&#8221; is defined as a person who is or has been entrusted with a
prominent public function in the executive (including regional governments in federalized systems and devolved administrations), legislative, administrative, foreign service (including ambassadors and charge d&#8217;affaires), military (including
high-ranking officers in the armed forces) or judicial branches of a government (whether elected or not), a senior official of a major political party (being a political party that has some representation in a national or supranational parliament or
similar legislative body), a senior executive of a government-owned corporation, members of courts of auditors or the board of a central bank. A &#8220;senior political figure&#8221; also includes the directors, deputy directors and members of the
board or equivalent of international public organizations. In addition, a &#8220;senior political figure&#8221; includes any corporation, business or other entity that has been formed by, or for the benefit of, a senior political figure.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">2</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">&#8220;<U>Immediate family</U>&#8221; of a senior political figure typically includes the political
figure&#8217;s parents, siblings, spouse (or person considered to be equivalent to a spouse), children (and their spouses or persons considered to be equivalent to a spouse) and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-laws.</FONT> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">3</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>close associate</U>&#8221; of a senior political figure is a person who is widely and publicly
known to maintain an unusually close relationship with the senior political figure, and includes a person who is in a position to conduct substantial financial transactions on behalf of the senior political figure. A &#8220;close associate&#8221;
also includes persons who are known to have joint beneficial ownership of legal entities or legal arrangements, or any other close business relations, with a senior political figure and natural persons who have sole beneficial ownership of a legal
entity or legal arrangement that is known to have been set up for the de facto benefit of a senior political figure. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">4</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>politically exposed person</U>&#8221; is defined under Cayman Islands law as (a)&nbsp;a person who
is or has been entrusted with prominent public functions by a foreign country, for example a Head of State or of government, senior politician, senior government, judicial or military official, senior executive of a state owned corporation, and
important political party official; (b)&nbsp;a person who is or has been entrusted domestically with prominent public functions, for example a Head of State or of government, senior politician, senior government, judicial or military official,
senior executives of a state owned corporation and important political party official; and (c)&nbsp;a person who is or has been entrusted with a prominent function by an international organization like a member of senior management, such as a
director, a deputy director and a member of the board or equivalent functions. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">5</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>family member&#8221;</U> of a politically exposed person includes the spouse, parent, sibling or
child of a politically exposed person. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">6</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A &#8220;<U>close associate&#8221;</U> of a politically exposed person means any natural person who is known to
hold the ownership or control of a legal instrument or person jointly with a politically exposed person, or who maintains some other kind of close business or personal relationship with a politically exposed person, or who holds the ownership or
control of a legal instrument or person which is known to have been established to the benefit of a politically exposed person. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
</div></div></DIV></Center>

like import in this Subscription Agreement shall, to the fullest extent permitted by law, be deemed to include electronic signatures or the keeping of records in electronic form, each of which shall be of the same legal effect, validity or
enforceability as a manually executed signature or the use of a paper-based recordkeeping system, as the case may be, to the extent and as provided for in any applicable law, including the Federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National
Commerce Act, the New York State Electronic Signatures and Records Act, the Delaware Uniform Electronic Transactions Act or any other similar state laws based on the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act and the Electronic Transactions Act (as
amended) of the Cayman Islands. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">12. The Investor acknowledges and agrees that any notations, alterations, strike-outs, addenda, inserts or
verbiage purporting to amend the terms of this Subscription Agreement shall not be effective unless explicitly agreed to by the Aranda Adviser and the OHA Adviser in writing. For the avoidance of doubt, the issuance of a trade confirmation or
contract note shall not be construed as the Aranda Adviser&#8217;s or OHA Adviser&#8217;s acceptance or agreement to any such purported amendments absent the explicit written agreement of the Aranda Adviser and the OHA Adviser. </P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Investor is an entity of a type not listed in Questions 2 or 3 above, not formed for the specific purpose
of acquiring the Units and with total &#8220;investments&#8221; (as defined in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2a51-1(b)</FONT> under the 1940 Act) in excess of $5,000,000. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">&#9744; </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">5.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Investor is a &#8220;family office&#8221; (as defined in Rule
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">202(a)(11)(G)-1</FONT> under the Advisers Act)&nbsp;(i) with assets under management in excess of $5,000,000, (ii) that is not formed for the specific purpose of acquiring the securities offered, and (iii)&nbsp;whose
prospective investment is directed by a person who has such knowledge and experience in financial and business matters that such family office is capable of evaluating the merits and risks of the prospective investment, or a &#8220;family
client&#8221; (as defined in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">202(a)(11)(G)-1</FONT> under the Advisers Act) of such family office and whose prospective investment in the Company is directed by such family office. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

access laws, any state or other jurisdiction&#8217;s laws with similar intent or effect to the FOIA, or any other similar statutory or legal right that might result in the disclosure of confidential information relating to the Company? </P>

additional explanatory information in the space below: </P><DIV STYLE="line-height:8.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000;width:11%">&nbsp;</DIV>

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">11</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">In determining the accredited investor status of entities for purposes of this Question 6, the Investor is
permitted to look through various forms of equity ownership to natural persons. If those natural persons are themselves accredited investors, and if all other equity owners of the Investor are accredited investors, then the Investor may check the
box next to Question 6 as an indication of the basis of the Investor&#8217;s status as an accredited investor. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

includes any natural person that is resident in the United States. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

of the Investment Company Act of 1940 but for Section&nbsp;3(c)(1) or 3(c)(7) of that Act. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

agency, authority, or instrumentality of the state or political subdivision; (ii)&nbsp;a plan or pool of assets controlled by the state or political subdivision or any agency, authority, or instrumentality thereof; and (iii)&nbsp;any officer, agent,
or employee of the state or political subdivision or any agency, authority, or instrumentality thereof, acting in their official capacity. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left"><div style="BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #000000;BORDER-LEFT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-RIGHT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-TOP:1px solid #000000;MARGIN-LEFT:0pt;MARGIN-RIGHT:0pt;max-width:100%">
<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-bottom:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">D.<B> </B><B><U>PAY TO PLAY</U></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. If the Investor is an entity substantially owned by a government entity (e.g., a single investor vehicle) and the investment decisions of
such entity are made or directed by such government entity, please provide the name of the government entity:<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">15</SUP> ______________________. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Please note that, if the Investor enters the name of a government entity in this Section F.1, the Company will treat the Investor as if
it were the government entity for purposes of Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">206(4)-5</FONT> (the &#8220;<U>Pay to Play Rule</U>&#8221;) promulgated under the Advisers Act. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. If the Investor is (a)&nbsp;a government entity, (b)&nbsp;acting as trustee, custodian or nominee for a beneficial owner that is a
government entity, or (c)&nbsp;an entity described in Section F.1, the Investor hereby certifies that: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Other than the Pay to Play Rule,
no &#8220;pay to play&#8221; or other similar compliance obligations would be imposed on the Company, the Aranda Adviser, the OHA Adviser or their respective affiliates, employees or third-party placement agents (if any) in connection with the
Investor&#8217;s subscription. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Please check the box to indicate that the Investor is making such certification.&#8194;&#9744; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>If the Investor cannot make such certification, indicate in the space below all other &#8220;pay to play&#8221; laws, rules or
guidelines, or lobbyist disclosure laws or rules, the Company, the Aranda Adviser, the OHA Adviser or their respective affiliates, employees or third-party placement agents (if any) would be subject to in connection with the Investor&#8217;s
subscription: </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>END OF INVESTOR QUESTIONNAIRE. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PLEASE PROCEED TO THE &#8220;INVESTOR DATA SHEET&#8221; </B><B><I>(</I></B><B></B><B><I><U>PART 3</U></I></B><B></B><B><I>)</I></B><B>

political subdivision of a State, including: (i)&nbsp;any agency, authority, or instrumentality of the State or political subdivision; (ii)&nbsp;a pool of assets sponsored or established by the State or political subdivision or any agency, authority
or instrumentality thereof, including, but not limited to a &#8220;defined benefit plan&#8221; as defined in section 414(j) of the Internal Revenue Code (26 U.S.C. 414(j)), or a State general fund; (iii)&nbsp;a plan or program of a government

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left"><div style="BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #000000;BORDER-LEFT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-RIGHT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-TOP:1px solid #000000;MARGIN-LEFT:0pt;MARGIN-RIGHT:0pt;max-width:100%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PART 5 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>PRIVACY NOTICE </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>COMMITMENT TO
PRIVACY </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Privacy Notice is provided by the Aranda Adviser, the OHA Adviser, and their respective affiliated entities (collectively, the
&#8220;<U>Firms</U>&#8221; or &#8220;<U>we</U>&#8221;). The Firms are committed to handling <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;non-public</FONT> personal information&#8221; and &#8220;personal data&#8221; relating to their respective natural
person clients and investors, and natural persons affiliated with their respective corporate clients and investors, responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws, rules and regulations. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Technology has dramatically changed the way information of all kinds is gathered, used and stored, but the importance of preserving the security and
confidentiality of information has remained a core value of both of the Firms. The Firms recognize and respect the privacy expectations of their clients, investors and their clients&#8217; and investors&#8217; affiliated individuals. Confidentiality
and protection of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> personal information and personal data are among its fundamental responsibilities. The Firms adhere to the policies and practices described in this Privacy Notice regardless of
whether a client or investor is a current or former client or investor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Privacy Notice is current as of the date hereof, but as circumstances or
requirements change, the Firms may need to amend this Privacy Notice. The Firms will notify their then-current clients and investors of any material amendment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Please provide this Privacy
Notice to any natural persons whose Personal Information (as defined below) may be provided to the Firms. In addition, to the extent the Firms are provided with sensitive <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-public</FONT> personal information (as
defined below), we recommend it is encrypted before being sent. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>KEY CONCEPTS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In this Privacy Notice, &#8220;<U>Relevant Individual</U>&#8221; means any natural person client or investor, or any natural person affiliated with a client or
investor (such as an employee, director, officer, partner, member, shareholder, beneficial owner, affiliate, agent or representative), who provides <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;non-public</FONT> personal information&#8221; or
&#8220;personal data&#8221; to the Firms. Such information may be provided through subscription agreements, investor questionnaires, investment advisory agreements, account applications, other forms or agreements and correspondence (written,
telephonic or electronic). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Personal data</U>&#8221; is certain information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person (as further
defined in the EU or UK General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and any relevant transposition of, or successor or replacement to, that regulation (together, the &#8220;<U>European Data Protection Legislation</U>&#8221;), in
the Cayman Islands Data Protection Act and related regulations, and any successor or replacement to such law or regulations (together, the &#8220;<U>Cayman Data Protection Legislation</U>&#8221;)) and other applicable laws and regulations relating
to privacy, data protection, breach notification, or the processing of personal information (collectively &#8220;<U>Applicable Privacy Laws</U>&#8221;). This Privacy Notice contains the information required to be disclosed under Applicable Privacy
Laws. For purposes of the Cayman Islands Data Protection Act, the Company is the data controller. &#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-public</FONT> personal information</U>&#8221; is any personally identifiable, financial information
relating to natural persons that is not publicly available. We refer in this Privacy Notice to &#8220;personal data&#8221; and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;non-public</FONT> personal information&#8221; together as &#8220;<U>Personal
Information</U>&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>PERSONAL INFORMATION COLLECTED </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firms may collect and process some or all of the following categories of Personal Information: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

background or identity information. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Where the client or investor is an individual, the Firms will usually collect this information
directly from the individual. Where the client or investor is a corporate entity, the Firms will usually collect the information from the client or investor or their professional advisors. In some cases, the Firms may receive the information from a
third party, such as a background check provider. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>USES OF PERSONAL INFORMATION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firms will use Personal Information for some or all of the following purposes: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Information in connection with entering into an investment relationship or during the course of that relationship, unless they note otherwise when making the request: (i)&nbsp;provision of the Personal Information is mandatory and in most cases is
necessary for the Firms to meet statutory or regulatory obligations, and (ii)&nbsp;failure to provide the information may result in denial of the opportunity to enter into, or remain in, the investment relationship. Please contact the Firms with any
questions about whether the provision of any particular Personal Information is required in any particular case. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>DISCLOSURES OF PERSONAL INFORMATION

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">From time to time, the Firms may also share a Relevant Individual&#8217;s Personal Information in other
situations, such as at the Relevant Individual&#8217;s request. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Personal Information may be transferred to countries that may not have the same or
equivalent data protection laws as those of the Relevant Individual&#8217;s home country. For example, the Personal Information may be transferred among the OHA Adviser&#8217;s offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Luxembourg, Australia
or Hong Kong, or the Aranda Adviser&#8217;s offices in the United States and Singapore, as well as to any other countries where the recipients of the transfers described above are located. Where required, the Firms make such transfers in compliance
with the Applicable Privacy Laws, such as through the use of model contractual clauses (as published by the European Commission). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECURITY OF PERSONAL
INFORMATION </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firms restrict access to Personal Information to those of their respective employees, partners, officers, consultants, advisors and
service providers who reasonably need to know that information to provide products or services to the relevant client or investor or as otherwise required by law. The Firms maintain physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards that comply with
applicable laws, rules and regulations to guard Personal Information. The specific security measures the Firms use in a particular context depend on that context, but the Firms draw from measures such as access controls, malware defenses,
encryption, facility security, and various monitoring strategies. The Firms also maintain incident response procedures. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>RETENTION OF PERSONAL
INFORMATION </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firms may retain Personal Information for so long as necessary for the purposes described above, unless a longer retention period is
required or permitted by applicable law. To provide security and business continuity for the activities described in this Privacy Notice, the Firms may make backups of certain data, which they may retain for longer than the original data. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>RIGHTS AND CHOICES </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Where the European Data Protection
Legislation or the Cayman Data Protection Legislation applies, Relevant Individuals may have the right to: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">In certain cases, object to the Firms&#8217; processing of their Personal Information. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">&#149;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Request access to their Personal Information (commonly known as a &#8220;data subject access request&#8221;).
This enables the Relevant Individual to receive a copy of the Personal Information the Firms hold about them as well as certain details about its processing to be able to check that the Firms are processing it lawfully. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Request correction of the Personal Information that the Firms hold about them. This enables Relevant Individuals
to have any incomplete or inaccurate information the Firms hold about them corrected. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">Request erasure of their Personal Information. This enables Relevant Individuals to ask the Firms to delete or
remove Personal Information if the Firms do not need to continue to process it. Relevant Individuals also have the right to ask the Firms to delete or remove their Personal Information where they have exercised their right to object to processing
(see above). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Firms to suspend the processing of their Personal Information if, for example, the Relevant Individual wants the Firms to establish their accuracy or the reason for processing it. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

format, or to have it transmitted in such format to a third party. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">These rights may apply under other Applicable Privacy Laws as well.
If a Relevant Individual wishes to exercise any of these rights, they should contact the Firms using the contact details below. The various rights are not absolute and each is subject to certain exceptions, qualifications and conditions. For
example, if a Relevant Individual wishes to object to processing, the Firms may need to discuss with the Relevant Individual whether its use of their Personal Information needs to continue for other lawful purposes, such as fulfilment of a legal or
contractual requirement. </P> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left"><div style="BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #000000;BORDER-LEFT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-RIGHT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-TOP:1px solid #000000;MARGIN-LEFT:0pt;MARGIN-RIGHT:0pt;max-width:100%">
<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-bottom:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firms will respond to a Relevant Individual&#8217;s request within the legally mandated deadline for a
response. In some cases, the Firms may not be able to fulfill the request to exercise the right by this date and may need more time. Where the Firms cannot provide a full response to the Relevant Individual for any reason, the Firms will let the
Relevant Individual know about this in its initial reply to the request. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Where these rights apply, a Relevant Individual will not normally have to pay a
fee to access their Personal Information (or to exercise any of the other rights described above). In some cases, the Firms may charge a reasonable fee if the request for access is unfounded or excessive, or if the Relevant Individual requests
multiple copies of the information. Alternatively, the Firms may refuse to comply with the request in such circumstances. The Firms may need to request specific information from the Relevant Individual to confirm their identity and ensure their
right to access the Personal Information (or to exercise any of their other rights). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">If Relevant Individuals have any questions, concerns or complaints
relating to the Firms&#8217; handling of their Personal Information, they should contact the Firms as described below. Relevant Individuals may also contact the relevant governmental authority (<I>e.g.</I>, the Cayman Islands Ombudsman, for Cayman
Islands funds, or the UK Information Commissioner&#8217;s Office, for UK individuals) with a complaint related to the Firms&#8217; handling of their Personal Information. However, the Firms invite Relevant Individuals to allow the Firms to try to
resolve the situation directly. Privacy is important to the Firms, and the Firms will do their best to address any concerns. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>CONTACTING THE FIRM
</B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">To exercise any rights under this Privacy Notice or applicable law (including to request further information on the mechanisms the Firms have put in
place in relation to Personal Information transfers outside the Cayman Islands, the European Union and/or the UK), to notify the Firms of your preferences, or to provide the Firms with complaints, concerns or questions, please contact the Firms via <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail.</FONT> </P> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PART 6 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TAX FORMS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Investor is required to
submit appropriate tax forms. If the Investor is two or more individuals that are purchasing the Units as either joint tenants with right of survivorship or
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">tenants-in-common,</FONT></FONT> please note that each individual must sign and complete the appropriate IRS form in accordance with its specific instructions. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Please carefully review the instructions accompanying the IRS form that the Investor is completing. The Advisor will not consider an IRS form complete
unless the Investor has submitted all statements, certifications or other documents required by the applicable IRS form. </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Please note that the
Investor may be required to provide updated tax forms (and certain other information from <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">time-to-time,</FONT></FONT> including, without limitation, revised forms that may be
published after the date hereof pursuant to FATCA). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The most current versions of the IRS Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9</FONT> and Forms <FONT

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><U>APPENDIX A </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>SAMPLE FORM OF CERTIFICATION </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>Part 1: Sample Form of Certification </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>The
second sentence can be removed if it is not a photo ID document</U>: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">I hereby certify that this is a true copy of the original documentation, which I have
seen. I further certify that the photograph in the identification document bears a true likeness to the individual named ____________________. This certification is made on this _____ day of ___________, 20__. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">To: APS BDC, LLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In connection with the

&#8220;<U>Intermediary</U>&#8221;) on behalf of third parties having a beneficial or economic interest in the Units subscribed for by the Intermediary (the &#8220;<U>Underlying Investors</U>&#8221;), the Intermediary hereby agrees to the following.
Capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meanings set forth in <U>Annex A</U> to this Certification of Intermediaries. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>I.

of its anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing policies, procedures and controls, and will thereafter immediately provide the Company, any administrator of the Company, the Aranda Adviser, and the OHA Adviser with any material
amendments thereto. The Intermediary represents and warrants that it strictly adheres to, and will at all times during its relationship with the Company strictly adhere to, its anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing policies,
procedures and controls. The Intermediary agrees to provide such information and execute and deliver such documents as the Company, any administrator of the Company, the Aranda Adviser, or the OHA Adviser may deem reasonably necessary to comply with
any and all laws and ordinances to which the Company, any administrator of the Company, the Aranda Adviser, or the OHA Adviser is or may be subject, or pursuant to any governmental or regulatory requests. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>III. <U>Provisions Relating to Underlying Investors</U>. </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">A.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Intermediary will, in accordance with its anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing policies,
procedures and controls, verify the identities of, identify the source of funds of, understand the ownership and control structure of, and conduct due diligence (and, where appropriate, enhanced due diligence) and obtain a description of the funds
that will be used to make capital contributions with regard to, any Underlying Investor and, where applicable, the principal beneficial owners on whose behalf an Underlying Investor is seeking to make an investment. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

Underlying Investor&#8217;s complete sale of its indirect interest in the Units, and agrees upon request to make such information available to the Company, any administrator of the Company, the Aranda Adviser, or the OHA Adviser and to provide a
written certificate of a senior officer of the Underlying Investor with respect to the foregoing. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

indirectly, for or on behalf of: </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

targeted on a sanctions list, is owned by, controlled by, or acting on behalf of a sanctioned person, or located or organized in a sanctioned jurisdiction or territory) under any of the following economic sanctions regimes: </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

(&#8220;<U>OFAC</U>&#8221;), Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security, or Department of State; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">c.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">the sanctions administered by the jurisdiction or jurisdictions of organization and operation of the
Intermediary, or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">d.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">such other jurisdictions as may be identified to the Intermediary by the Company, any administrator of the
Company, the Aranda Adviser, or the OHA Adviser; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="8%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">3.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">a person or entity located, organized, or operating in a country or territory that is, or that itself is
(a)&nbsp;designated as <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-cooperative</FONT> with international anti-money laundering principles or procedures by an intergovernmental group or organization, such as the Financial Action Task Force, of which each of
the United States and the United Kingdom is a member, (b)&nbsp;the subject of an advisory issued by the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network of the U.S. Treasury Department, or (c)&nbsp;designated by the Secretary of the Treasury under
Section&nbsp;311 of the USA PATRIOT Act as warranting special measures due to money laundering concerns (any of (a), (b) or (c), a &#8220;<U>Prohibited Investor</U>&#8221;). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">D.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Prior to making an investment for or on behalf of a high-risk Underlying Investor, the Intermediary will
conduct enhanced due diligence with regard to such high-risk Underlying Investor, as provided by the Intermediary&#8217;s anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing policies, procedures and controls, in addition to the
Intermediary&#8217;s routine investor identification procedures, and reasonably confirm that such high-risk Underlying Investor is not violating applicable anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing laws and regulations.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>IV. <U>Provisions Relating to Suspicious Activity</U>. </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">A.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Intermediary represents and warrants that (a)&nbsp;it has taken reasonable steps to confirm whether any
Underlying Investor (or any person or entity having a beneficial interest in the Underlying Investor) is, or has in the last 12 months been, a Senior Political Figure, or a member of a current Senior Political Figure&#8217;s Immediate Family or a
Close Associate of a current Senior Political Figure and (b)&nbsp;to the extent the Intermediary confirms that an Underlying Investor (or any person or entity having a beneficial interest in the Underlying Investor) is, or has in the last 12 months
been, a current Senior Political Figure, a member of a </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
</div></div></DIV></Center>

<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-bottom:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">
current Senior Political Figure&#8217;s Immediate Family or a Close Associate of a current Senior Political Figure, it has undertaken additional due diligence with respect to such Underlying
Investor (and such person or entity having a beneficial interest in such Underlying Investor) to reasonably confirm that their direct or indirect beneficial interests in the Company do not violate any applicable anti-money laundering and
counter-terrorist financing laws or regulations. </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">B.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Intermediary will immediately notify the Company, any administrator of the Company, the Aranda Adviser, and
the OHA Adviser if it knows, or has reason to suspect, that an existing or prospective Underlying Investor, or the principal beneficial owners on whose behalf an existing or prospective Underlying Investor has made or is seeking to make an
investment, is a Prohibited Investor. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">C.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">The Intermediary agrees immediately to notify the Company, any administrator of the Company, the Aranda
Adviser, and the OHA Adviser if it becomes aware of any suspicious activity or pattern of activity or any activity that may require further review to determine whether the activity or pattern of activities is suspicious. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left"><div style="BORDER-BOTTOM:1px solid #000000;BORDER-LEFT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-RIGHT:1px solid #000000;BORDER-TOP:1px solid #000000;MARGIN-LEFT:0pt;MARGIN-RIGHT:0pt;max-width:100%">
<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-bottom:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL &amp; TRADE SECRET </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><U>ANNEX A </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>ANNEX A TO CERTIFICATION OF INTERMEDIARIES </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>DEFINITIONS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Close
Associate</U>&#8221; of a senior political figure is a person who is widely and publicly known to maintain an unusually close relationship with the senior political figure, and includes a person who is in a position to conduct substantial financial
transactions on behalf of the senior political figure. A &#8220;close associate&#8221; also includes persons who are known to have joint beneficial ownership of legal entities or legal arrangements, or any other close business relations, with a
senior political figure and natural persons who have sole beneficial ownership of a legal entity or legal arrangement that is known to have been set up for the de facto benefit of a senior political figure. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Foreign Bank</U>&#8221; means an organization that (i)&nbsp;is organized under the laws of a foreign country, (ii)&nbsp;engages in the business of
banking, (iii)&nbsp;is recognized as a bank by the bank supervisory or monetary authority of the country of its organization or principal banking operations, (iv)&nbsp;receives deposits to a substantial extent in the regular course of its business,
and (v)&nbsp;has the power to accept demand deposits, but does not include the U.S. branches or agencies of a foreign bank. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Foreign Shell
Bank</U>&#8221; means a Foreign Bank without a Physical Presence in any country, but does not include a Regulated Affiliate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Immediate
Family</U>&#8221; includes the political figure&#8217;s parents, siblings, spouse (or person considered to be equivalent to a spouse), children (and their spouses or persons considered to be equivalent to a spouse) and
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-laws.</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Physical Presence</U>&#8221; means a place of business that is maintained by a Foreign Bank
and is located at a fixed address, other than solely a post office box or an electronic address, in a country in which the Foreign Bank is authorized to conduct banking activities, at which location the Foreign Bank (i)&nbsp;employs one or more
individuals on a full-time basis, (ii)&nbsp;maintains operating records related to its banking activities, and (iii)&nbsp;is subject to inspection by the banking authority that licensed the Foreign Bank to conduct banking activities. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Regulated Affiliate</U>&#8221; means a Foreign Shell Bank that (i)&nbsp;is an affiliate of a depository institution, credit union or Foreign Bank
that maintains a Physical Presence in the United States or a foreign country, as applicable, and (ii)&nbsp;is subject to supervision by a banking authority in the country regulating such affiliated depository institution, credit union or Foreign
Bank. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Senior Political Figure</U>&#8221; is defined as a person who is or has been entrusted with a prominent public function in the executive
(including regional governments in federalized systems and devolved administrations), legislative, administrative, foreign service (including ambassadors and charge d&#8217;affaires), military (including high-ranking officers in the armed forces) or
judicial branches of a government (whether elected or not), a senior official of a major political party (being a political party that has some representation in a national or supranational parliament or similar legislative body), a senior executive
of a government-owned corporation, members of courts of auditors or the board of a central bank. A &#8220;senior political figure&#8221; also includes the directors, deputy directors and members of the board or equivalent of international public
organizations. In addition, a &#8220;senior political figure&#8221; includes any corporation, business or other entity that has been formed by, or for the benefit of, a senior political figure. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>USA PATRIOT Act</U>&#8221; means the Uniting and Strengthening America by Providing Appropriate Tools Required to Intercept and Obstruct Terrorism
(USA PATRIOT) Act of 2001 (Pub. L. No.&nbsp;107). </P> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
</div></div></DIV></Center>
